label: Format on save
help: Runs the language server's formatter every time a file is saved.

label: Updates
help: Automatic checks every 4 hours and downloads the new version in the background; Notify only shows a notice; Off never checks (the "Check for updates" command still works).

label: Minimap
help: Shows a thumbnail of the file at the right edge of the editor.

label: Minimap style
help: Subtle is narrower and low-contrast; Normal is the original look.

label: Word wrap
help: Wraps long lines at the window width instead of scrolling horizontally.

label: Sticky scroll
help: Keeps the enclosing scopes (function, class) visible at the top while you scroll.

label: Tab width
help: How many columns a tab character takes in the editor (2, 4 or 8). Per-file indentation stays in the bottom bar.

label: Indent guides
help: Draws thin vertical lines at the indentation levels.

label: Breadcrumbs
help: Shows the file path and symbols above the editor. When off, the editor takes the row's space.

label: Appearance mode
help: Fixed uses the chosen theme; System follows the desktop light/dark setting.

label: Theme
help: Color theme used in fixed mode.

label: Light theme
help: Theme used when the system is in light mode (appearance: system).

label: Dark theme
help: Theme used when the system is in dark mode (appearance: system).

label: Interface colors
help: Derived keeps the usual calm, flat look; From theme uses the theme's own sidebar, tabs and bottom bar when the text stays legible (the rest falls back to the derived look).

label: Interface scale
help: Scale for hi-DPI screens (0.5 to 4). 0 = automatic, uses the system scale (LUMEN_SCALE is also accepted).

label: Scroll speed
help: Mouse wheel speed (0.1 to 5). 1 = 3 lines per notch, like Zed. Touchpads always scroll exactly with the fingers.

label: Hide git-ignored files
help: Leaves out of the explorer what .gitignore, the global ignore file and .git/info/exclude ignore. Off shows them dimmed.

label: Auto import
help: Automatically adds missing imports when you accept a suggestion.

label: Lean mode
help: Opt-in for low-RAM machines: the TypeScript server only sees open files and their imports (less memory, but references, rename, workspace symbols and errors in other files are incomplete). Off = the whole project, like VS Code.

label: Code lens
help: Shows reference and implementation counts next to symbols (costs server CPU).

label: Code lens: references
help: Shows "N references" (needs Code lens on).

label: Code lens: implementations
help: Shows "N implementations" (needs Code lens on).

label: Inlay hints
help: Shows inferred types and parameter names in gray inside the code (visible lines only).

label: Inlay hints: parameters
help: Shows the parameter name before each argument (needs Inlay hints on).

label: Inlay hints: types
help: Shows inferred types of variables, parameters and returns; double-click a type to insert the annotation, Ctrl+click goes to the definition (needs Inlay hints on).

label: tsgo source
help: Automatic uses the project's tsgo if installed, otherwise the bundled one.

label: Pull strategy
help: How Pull integrates the remote commits when the histories have diverged. "Ask" shows the choice on the spot; you can also change it by right-clicking Pull.

label: Git blame on line
help: Shows the author and date of the last commit on the cursor line, in gray at the end of the line. Also available as the "Toggle git blame" command.

label: Search in project
help: Project search button (left corner).

label: Problems
help: Error and warning counts (left corner).

label: Line and column
help: Cursor position (Ln, Col) and number of cursors.

label: Indentation
help: The file's spaces or tabs.

label: Language
help: Language of the active file.

label: Encoding
help: Encoding of the active file (UTF-8, UTF-16, Windows-1252…); click to reopen or save it in another one.

label: Terminal
help: Button that opens the integrated terminal.

label: Debug
help: Button that opens the debug panel.

label: Git
help: Git panel button with the changed-file count.

label: Memory
help: Memory use of the editor and the language servers.

label: Order: Sidebar
help: Position in the left group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Search in project
help: Position in the left group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Problems
help: Position in the left group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Line and column
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Indentation
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Encoding
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Language
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Terminal
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Debug
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Git
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Order: Memory
help: Position in the right group (1 = leftmost); − and + move it, skipping hidden items.

label: Buffer font
help: Family of the code editor and everything monospace (terminal, output, diffs, code blocks). Click to search the installed fonts or type a name; a missing family falls back to the system monospace.

label: Buffer font size
help: Code text size in pixels (8 to 40). Ctrl + mouse wheel and Ctrl +/- adjust it too.

label: Buffer font weight
help: 100 Thin, 200 Extra Light, 300 Light, 400 Regular, 500 Medium, 600 Semi Bold, 700 Bold, 800 Extra Bold, 900 Black. The nearest weight the family has is used.

label: Buffer line height
help: Row height as a multiple of the font size (1.0 to 2.5). In config.json a number above 4 means pixels.

label: Buffer ligatures
help: Joins sequences such as => and != into one glyph when the font has them. Each ligature keeps the width of its characters and the caret still moves one character at a time.

label: Interface font
help: Family of the sidebar, tabs, menus, dialogs, status bar and hover text. Click to search the installed fonts or type a name.

label: Interface font size
help: Interface text size in pixels (10 to 20).

label: Interface font weight
help: 100 to 900; the nearest weight the family has is used. Bold interface text stays heavier than this.

label: Interface line height
help: Line spacing of multi-line interface text such as hover cards, as a multiple of the font size (1.0 to 2.5). Single-line labels keep their rows.

label: Interface ligatures
help: Uses the interface font's standard and contextual ligatures.

label: Line numbers
help: Shows the line numbers in the gutter. Without them the gutter shrinks to the marks and the fold arrows.

label: Bookmarks
help: Shows bookmark marks in the gutter. Ctrl+F2 toggles a bookmark, Ctrl+Alt+F2 and Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F2 jump to the next and previous one.

label: Breakpoints
help: Shows breakpoint dots in the gutter and lets you click the gutter to toggle one. Off hides them and the click; debugging still stops at them.

label: Scrollbars
help: Never (the default) hides them (the wheel, touchpad and keys still scroll); Show keeps the thin bars visible; Auto fades them in while you scroll or point at them.

label: Language servers
help: Master switch: off stops every language server (no diagnostics, hover, completion or go to definition) and the status bar says so. On starts them again when needed.

label: Spell checking
help: Underlines spelling and grammar slips in comments, strings, Markdown, plain text and commit messages with a dotted info line (never an error), through the companion servers harper-ls and typos-lsp. They start only when installed; Ctrl+. offers the fixes and "add to dictionary".

label: Inline completions
help: Faded suggestions at the cursor from language servers that offer them (LSP inline completion), such as GitHub Copilot's copilot-language-server once you install it (npm i -g @github/copilot-language-server) and run "Copilot: Sign in". Tab accepts, Ctrl+Right accepts a word, Esc dismisses, Alt+] / Alt+[ show other suggestions, Alt+\\ asks now. Lumen never handles API keys.

label: Markdown remote images
help: Lets the Markdown reader download http(s) images (badges, screenshots) into a local cache. Off keeps a placeholder card instead, so opening a README contacts no server.

label: Render whitespace
help: Draws spaces as faint dots and tabs as arrows. Boundary shows all but single spaces between words, Trailing only the whitespace at line ends. The palette command "Toggle render whitespace" switches it on and off.

label: Trim trailing whitespace on save
help: Removes spaces and tabs at the end of lines when saving, as one undo step. Markdown files are left alone (two trailing spaces are a line break there); an .editorconfig can decide per file.

label: Insert final newline on save
help: Ends the file with a line break when saving, if it has none. An .editorconfig can decide per file.

label: Rulers
help: Columns where thin vertical guide lines are drawn, separated by commas (for example 80, 120). Empty: none. A project's .editorconfig max_line_length adds one.

label: Inline diagnostics
help: Shows the most severe problem of a line after its code, faded and cut to the room left: Current line (the default) only on the caret's line, All on every line, Off never. Never drawn over the text.

label: Problems scope
help: What the Problems panel lists: open_files (the diagnostics of the open documents) or project (also what the language servers report for files that are not open, asked with workspace pull diagnostics where supported). Alt+W in the panel switches it.

label: Right-to-left paragraphs
help: Lines with Arabic, Hebrew or Persian text are shown in visual order. Auto gives each line the direction of its first letter (a Hebrew line reads from the right); Ltr keeps every line left to right and only reorders the right-to-left words inside it.

label: Build command
help: A build command of your own, run by the shell in the project folder (Build panel, Ctrl+Shift+B). It is listed first among the targets and its output is read for compiler problems. Empty: only what is detected (Cargo, npm / pnpm / yarn / bun, Maven, Gradle, .NET, Go, CMake, Make).

label: Run command
help: A run command of your own for the Build panel's Run (Ctrl+F5), run by the shell in the project folder.

label: Hot exit
help: Quitting keeps unsaved changes (untitled tabs too) and reopens them next time instead of asking to save. Unsaved changes are also backed up a few seconds after each edit, so a crash loses almost nothing. Off asks before quitting, as before.

label: Persistent undo
help: Keeps each file's undo history after it is closed (and across restarts), as long as the file was not changed elsewhere. Up to 2 MB per file; the oldest histories are dropped first.

label: Desktop notifications
help: Shows a system notification when an agent session is waiting for you or done while Lumen is in the background (once per turn).

label: Diff: ignore whitespace
help: Side-by-side diffs ignore changes in spaces, tabs and line endings (git diff -w): such lines do not count as changed and are not highlighted. Staging a hunk or lines still stages their real text. Also a toggle in the diff header (key W).
